about_the_game:
Step into the fur of these rookie thieves on a mission to pull off the ultimate heist: steal the Golden Can of Tuna!

Crimanimals is a roguelike escape adventure filled with traps, puzzles, and physics-driven chaos. As you explore the luxurious but treacherous casino rooms, any object can become a threat: solve the puzzles and move forward, or fail and start all over again. No progress, no mercy… just laughs, gadgets, and the sweet taste of glorious tuna at the end.

  • Choose your criminal animal – Pick your favorite character and join the most absurd heist of the century.

  • Interactive physics puzzles – Examine objects, throw them around, combine clues, and find creative solutions to progress. Nothing is what it seems, and even harmless items can turn into deadly hazards.

  • Co-op or Solo Play – Sneak in alone or bring friends along for a cooperative escape-room experience.

  • Every attempt matters – Death resets the heist. Fail a puzzle and you’ll have to start from scratch, but every run brings new laughs, slapstick fails, and unpredictable chaos.

Will you outsmart the casino and claim the Golden Can of Tuna, or become just another failed thief in the history books?

  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 4000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 6GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: PC, Mouse, Keyboard or Controller

short_description: Become an animal thief, solo or with friends, and take on the ultimate heist: stealing the legendary Golden Can of Tuna. Dangerous puzzles, absurd traps, and crazy physics await in this roguelike escape room. Will you survive the chaos and pull off the heist?
